q: What happens when the patient is sat up to check symmetry?
why: Venous pooling causes hypotension; secure the airway and pad well before sitting up.

q: Why give tranexamic acid in breast reduction?
why: Breast reduction is vascular surgery with a risk of haematoma.

q: Why is TIVA often chosen for breast surgery?
o: It reduces PONV in a high-risk group
why: Young women having breast surgery are at high PONV risk.
